besluite.fout: 'al kleiner' is the stiffer, bookish form of the gradual-increase idiom.
besluite.rede: 'al hoe kleiner' is the natural spoken Afrikaans idiom for a Grade 6 reader and the meaning is unchanged.
Fronting 'So 'n siekte' deliberately links back to the previous sentence; the proposal is a lateral reorder that loosens that link.
This is a glossary definition and the repeated 'kan' is correct Afrikaans, so there is no real fault to justify rewording it.
